Strings.permission.request.title: Permission request
Strings.permission.request.prompt: Would you like to allow this application to use the following permission?
Strings.permission.request.later_hint: You can decide later in this application's Settings permissions page.
Strings.permission.server.files.read.description: Read files, directory structure, and basic metadata on the server.
Strings.permission.server.files.write.descriptio: Create, upload, edit, rename, and delete server files. This does not include changing file ownership or system permissions.
Strings.permission.server.processes.manage.descr: View, start, stop, or terminate server processes. This permission includes reading the process list.
Strings.permission.server.services.manage.descri: View, start, stop, or restart services on the server.
Strings.permission.server.network.read.descripti: Read network interfaces, IP addresses, routes, and connection state.
Strings.permission.server.network.configure.desc: Change server IP addresses, routes, DNS, and other network configuration. It does not grant unrelated management capabilities.
Strings.permission.server.power.manage.descripti: Request high-impact server operations such as restart or shutdown.
Strings.permission.desktop.wallpaper.write.descr: Allow this application to change the current workspace wallpaper through RelaxKonOS.
Strings.permission.server.metrics.read.descripti: Read aggregate CPU, memory, disk, network, and GPU metrics from the server.
Strings.permission.server.docker.read.descriptio: View local Docker status and resource metadata on the server.
Strings.permission.server.docker.manage.descript: Create and change local Docker containers, images, and Compose stacks.
Strings.permission.server.guardian.read.descript: View the Guardian Agent, workloads, states, and sanitized logs.
Strings.permission.server.guardian.manage.descri: Create and control workloads supervised by the Guardian Agent.
Strings.permission.server.firewall.read.descript: View the Linux server firewall status, defaults, and rules.
Strings.permission.server.firewall.manage.descri: Change the Linux server firewall status, default policies, and rules.
Strings.permission.server.certificates.read.desc: View TLS/SSL certificate metadata, issuance status, and renewal state on the server.
Strings.permission.server.certificates.manage.de: Request, renew, deploy, revoke, and delete TLS certificates on the server.
Strings.permission.server.webservers.read.descri: View discovered web servers, their runtime status, and configuration metadata on the server.
Strings.permission.server.webservers.manage.desc: Integrate, reload, and test web server configuration on the server.
Strings.permission.server.git.read.description: View registered Git repositories, their status, branches, history, and diffs on the server.
Strings.permission.server.git.manage.description: Commit, pull, push, switch, create and delete branches, and revert commits in registered Git repositories on the server.
Strings.permission.server.tunnels.read.descripti: View safe tunnel, FRP server profile, runtime, and sanitized log state on the server.
Strings.permission.server.tunnels.manage.descrip: Create, change, apply, stop, and delete server tunnel configuration and FRP runtime settings.
